title: AI Marketing Tracker record
description: One record = one marketing, communications or launch move around AI. The subject is how the work was made, staged and received, not what was deployed.

id.description: Stable unique slug. Used for dedup.

company.description: Whoever did the marketing, e.g. Anthropic, HSBC.

subject.description: What is being marketed: the model, product or programme name.

description.description: 1-3 sentence summary of what was done.

angle.description: The positioning in one line: the claim, the message, the register.

craft_note.description: What is notable in the execution: casting, music, direction, staging, copy, media buy.

asset_url.description: Direct link to the ad, film, keynote recording or landing page, when distinct from the source article. Empty otherwise.

spend.description: Reported spend or media weight as text. Empty if not reported.

agency.description: Creative agency or studio, if named.

outcome.description: Measured reception: views, earned coverage, sign-ups, sentiment, award, backlash. Not disclosed where nothing was reported.

metric.description: Short scannable metric, empty if none.

digest_line.description: One standalone sentence under ~160 chars for the weekly digest.

source_channel.description: For example trade press, newsroom, keynote.
